decision.summary: Tenant says the landlord-supplied LG washer is dead and offers to replace it with their own machine. This needs landlord consent, so I requested it, told the tenant not to buy yet, and put the job on hold with a review date.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: At intake, routine. Outstanding: landlord consent to tenant-owned replacement (or repair decision), ownership/removal terms, tenant photo.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Landlord approval request APR-101 to the landlord; email to tenant; hold until 2025-07-30.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Not an agency human; the decision is the landlord's, as the machine is their property and the tenant wants to substitute their own. No escalation now.

assumptions: The machine is part of the landlord's furnishings, as the tenant says it was there at move-in

args.decision_needed: The tenant reports the LG washing machine supplied with the flat has a power failure and they believe it can't be repaired. They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost, which would remain their property and be removed when they leave. Do you consent to this? Alternatively, do you want to repair or replace it yourself, with our contractor or your own?
options: Consent to tenant replacing at own cost; tenant keeps and removes it at end of tenancy (old machine removed/disposed)
Landlord repairs or replaces the machine via our contractor

args.body: Hello, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine, and for offering to replace it. As the machine came with the flat, we need the landlord's consent before you replace it, and we've now asked them. Please hold off buying or removing anything until we confirm. We'll note that a machine you buy would be yours to take when you leave, and we'll ask the landlord to agree that in writing. If you can, please send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you once the landlord replies.
